hypothesis: Frozen/stalling live playback on panel gmaster1.shop (639563670/334918348)

runtimeEvidence.sourceDimensions: 1920x1080 DAR=1.7778 H.264 (bare mpv, 3 distinct channel URLs, no app profile, no VO)
runtimeEvidence.measuredThroughput: ~4000 kbps sustained, cache filling from zero
runtimeEvidence.appPauseLog: live pausou por falta de byte { folgaSecs: 0.124, cacheSecs: 49.06, tempoPos: 48.94, colchao: 8 }

findings.claim: The live demuxer byte ceiling (4 MiB) was calibrated on a panel measured at ~240 kbps, and on a higher-bitrate panel it caps runway below one HLS segment, making the freeze structural rather than tunable.
findings.evidence: live-buffer-limits.cjs header records the derivation: '4 MiB = 138,9 s -> bitrate real ~ 30 KB/s ~ 240 kbps'. Live probe on the target panel measured ~4000 kbps sustained at 1920x1080. 4 MiB at 4000 kbps = 8.4 s of runway; the panel publishes a segment every 10-11 s. Runtime log shows folgaSecs 0.124 with colchao: 8.
findings.runtimeTrigger: Play any live channel on a panel whose bitrate exceeds ~2.5 Mbps. The demuxer cannot buffer a whole segment, so paused-for-cache fires on each publication boundary.

findings.claim: demuxer-max-bytes reaches mpv over IPC after loadfile, while the sibling setting cache-pause-initial was deliberately moved to the command line for exactly that reason. The file documents the rule and then violates it.
findings.evidence: stur-player.cjs:4296-4299 states 'O perfil chega por IPC DEPOIS do loadfile ... O que vale e o que esta na linha de comando', and cache-pause-initial=yes was moved to argv for that reason. demuxer-max-bytes was left in the profile at line 83. Comment at stur-player.cjs:4272-4284 also names 'tres literais iguais sao tres chances de divergirem em silencio'.
findings.runtimeTrigger: Any playback whose correct max-bytes differs from the argv literal. The process runs with the argv value until the profile lands, then switches mid-stream.

findings.claim: The live process starts with a 96 MiB demuxer ceiling, 24x the intended live value, so the first moments of every playback run under a constraint the project explicitly rejects.
findings.evidence: '--demuxer-max-bytes=96MiB' is unconditional in buildMpvArgs. live-buffer-limits.test.cjs:52 asserts LIVE_MAX_BYTES_PADRAO must not equal 96 MiB because 'o padrao antigo produz o gaguejo'.
findings.runtimeTrigger: Every live loadfile, before the profile IPC lands.

findings.claim: escreverManifesto reads state.targetDuration, which is never assigned anywhere in the module; the emitted TARGETDURATION is derived only from segment durations.
findings.evidence: createWindowState (line 94-117) does not define targetDuration. alinhar (line 152-232) never assigns painel.targetDuration to state. Line 247 reads state.targetDuration || 0, so the panel's declared value is silently discarded.
findings.runtimeTrigger: Any panel whose declared TARGETDURATION exceeds the longest EXTINF duration.

findings.claim: The runtime log field mode reports a value ('raw') that is not in loadModeOrder's output, so the log does not identify which load path actually ran.
findings.evidence: live-load-policy.cjs:203 returns ['normalize','direct','ffmpeg'] for live. currentLoadMode is only ever assigned 'direct', 'direct-ts', 'http', 'ffmpeg' (lines 2504, 4006, 4017, 4025, 4071, 4082, 4098, 4104, 4111). The log line emits mode: 'raw', a value absent from both sets.
findings.runtimeTrigger: Every live playback; the emitted mode field is not comparable to the policy that produced it.

notes: BUG-1 is the one that matches the reported symptom. BUG-2/BUG-3 are the same configuration-coherence defect seen from two sides. BUG-5 is recorded because instrumentation that misreports state has already cost this project one wrong diagnosis (demuxer-cache-time read as runway).
